name: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl)
rate_limits: Free key: 300 calls per 10 seconds, 2,000 per 10 minutes, 50,000 a day (search summary of Nasdaq's rate limit page, which now redirects).
what_it_has: A marketplace of mostly paid datasets with a small set of free ones. The free continuous futures set (CHRIS) is deprecated and no longer updated.
simple: A data shop run by the Nasdaq exchange. Most of the good stuff costs money now.
license_terms: Each dataset has its own license; free datasets carry their publisher's terms.
quality_notes: Many free datasets are stale or retired. What remains free is mostly also on FRED. CHRIS deprecation is from a third party citing Nasdaq support (unverified).

relevance.reason: Little left for free that FRED does not already have.
